title: Baluchistan Medical Graduates Compulsory Service Act 1974

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Medical Graduates Compulsory Service Act 1974
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

BALUCHISTAN MEDICAL GRADUATES
BALUCHISTAN
MEDICAL GRADUATES
(COMPULSORY
SERVICE) ACT, 1974
ACT XX OF 1974
An Act to requisition the services of medical graduates
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 18th December 1974]
(First published after having received the assent of the
Governor of Baluchistan in the Baluchistan Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 18th
December 1974.)
No. Legis. X-(20)/74.-The
Baluchistan Medical Graduates (Compulsory Service) Bill, 1974, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balu chistan on 4th December 1974 and
assented to by the Governor of Baluchistan is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly:-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Baluchistan Medical
Graduates (Compulsory Service) Act, 1974.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
(3) It shall apply to the
Province of Baluchistan except the Tribal Areas.

No. Legis. X-(20)/74.-The
Baluchistan Medical Graduates (Compulsory Service) Bill, 1974, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balu chistan on 4th December 1974 and
assented to by the Governor of Baluchistan is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly:-
2. Definitions.----In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant, in the subject or context-
(i) "Government" means
the Government of Baluchistan.
(ii) "Medical Graduate"
means a person who has graduated in the faculty of medicine and surgery or has
undertaken any post-graduate or higher degree in medicine or surgery at the
expense of the Government of Baluchistan or has studied in any other College or
Institution against the reserved seats of the former Quetta and Kalat Divisions
(now Baluchistan) or was nominated or may be nominated by the Government for
studies abroad.

sections.description:
Requisitioning of Service

BALUCHISTAN MEDICAL GRADUATES
BALUCHISTAN
MEDICAL GRADUATES
(COMPULSORY
SERVICE) ACT, 1974
ACT XX OF 1974
An Act to requisition the services of medical graduates
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 18th December 1974]
(First published after having received the assent of the
Governor of Baluchistan in the Baluchistan Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 18th
December 1974.)
No. Legis. X-(20)/74.-The
Baluchistan Medical Graduates (Compulsory Service) Bill, 1974, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balu chistan on 4th December 1974 and
assented to by the Governor of Baluchistan is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly:-
3. Requisitioning of
Service.----Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law, a Medical
Graduate shall be liable to serve
the Province of Baluchistan for a period of at least five years, if so required
by Government,--
(a) if he has graduated on or
after the first day of July 1970, but before the commencement of this Act,
within one year of the date of commencement of this Act;
(b) if he graduates after the
commencement of this Act, within one year of his graduation.

4. Offence and Penalty.---Whoever
disobeys the order of Government with respect to the requisitioning of his
service or in any other manner defies the notice issued by the Government,
shall suffer imprisonment for two years and shall also be liable to fine which
may extend to ten thousand rupees.
